_comment: NSE/BSE trading holidays. PARTIAL — fixed-date national holidays only, which I can state with confidence. The lunar/variable holidays (Holi, Good Friday, Eid, Ram Navami, Mahavir Jayanti, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Diwali/Laxmi Pujan, Guru Nanak Jayanti, Bakri Eid, Muharram) MUST be added from the official NSE/BSE holiday circular for each year — they are NOT fabricated here. is_trading_day() fails SAFE: a date not listed is treated as a trading day and real market data confirms it, so a missing holiday only causes a harmless empty session, never a wrong trade.
source: fixed-date national holidays; variable dates pending official NSE circular
